post.description: Find projects in the selected workspace without fetching additional context.

200.description: Matching project names, capped by the requested limit.

422.description: Projection of input validation failure before dispatch. A future HTTP host must implement this mapping.

default.description: Approval, policy, and execution failures require a host-defined HTTP mapping. No HTTP error endpoint or automatic retry behavior is implemented.

code.description: Stable diagnostic category such as `type`, `unknown_property`, or `invalid_schema`.

message.description: Explanation of the violated contract, intended for developers rather than policy decisions.

path.description: Value location: generated validators use JSON Pointer with an empty root; legacy parsers use slash paths with `/` at the root.

items.description: A validation diagnostic. Paths identify values without including their contents.

issues.description: Field paths and reasons, without echoing the rejected values or host context.

status.description: Stable discriminator used by adapters to distinguish pre-dispatch validation failure.

ToolInputValidationFailure.description: Input rejected before authorization or handler execution by the lightweight runtime.

limit.description: Maximum returned matches. Omission uses the handler's limit of 10.

query.description: Text to find within a project name; empty searches are rejected.

Tool0Input.description: Case-insensitive search over the project names explicitly supplied by the host.

projects.description: Names within the selected host context. No project metadata is fetched.

Tool0Output.description: Matching names in the host's original order; an empty list is a successful search.
